answer: Ambient Beacon Timing Registry: each agent broadcasts a beacon tied to its physical clock drift, and neighbors log arrival times to a shared knoll of timestamp fingerprints. Enforcement rule: an identity is admitted only if its drift signature matches a hardware oscillator physically present at a declared location across many independent observers. To forge N identities, an attacker must supply N distinct physical devices at N locations, since one operator's clock cannot occupy two places at once. Per-identity cost: one device plus hosting, no cheap software shortcut.
